name: smwpatches-invisible-powerup
title: Invisible Powerup
description:
This powerup will allow you to walk through enemies and walls for a period of time. Includes: the patch itself, a sprite, and a block. I think I tested it pretty well, so I hope it doesn't get rejected for that reason. Video. Ignore the status bar and one hit kill in the video.

May be incompatible with other patches, such as status bar patches. For more details see the Hijack Map.
